title: Prescription Insurance on File Refill Thresholds and Early-Claim Override Allowances by Plan Class
content:
Under **Prescription Insurance on File**, each plan class sets how much of the previous paid claim's supply must be used before the plan pays the next routine claim, and which early-claim override codes it accepts and how often.

## Settings

- **Plan early refill threshold** — percent of the previous paid claim's days supply that must elapse before the plan pays the next routine claim.
- **Vacation-supply overrides per plan year** — vacation-supply overrides the plan pays per prescription per plan year.
- **Lost-or-stolen overrides per plan year** — lost-or-stolen overrides the plan pays per prescription per plan year.
- **Therapy-change override** — whether a therapy-change override is paid when the dose changed.
- **Accepted override codes** — the submission clarification codes the plan class accepts on an early claim.

## Schedule

| Plan class | Threshold (percent) | Vacation-supply overrides per plan year | Lost-or-stolen overrides per plan year | Therapy-change override | Accepted override codes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Medicaid Managed Care Pharmacy Benefit | 85 | 0 | 1 | Yes | lost or stolen; therapy change |
| Medicare Part D Standard Plan | 75 | 1 | 1 | Yes | vacation supply; lost or stolen; therapy change |
| Medicare Part D Enhanced Plan | 75 | 2 | 1 | Yes | vacation supply; lost or stolen; therapy change |
| Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug Plan | 75 | 1 | 1 | Yes | vacation supply; lost or stolen; therapy change |
| Commercial High-Deductible Health Plan | 80 | 2 | 1 | Yes | vacation supply; lost or stolen; therapy change |
| Commercial Copay Plan | 80 | 2 | 1 | Yes | vacation supply; lost or stolen; therapy change |
| Workers' Compensation Pharmacy Benefit | 85 | 0 | 0 | Yes | therapy change |

## Reading the table

- The vacation supply code is not accepted by the Medicaid Managed Care Pharmacy Benefit or the Workers' Compensation Pharmacy Benefit, and both show 0 vacation-supply overrides.
- The Workers' Compensation Pharmacy Benefit accepts only the therapy change code and pays 0 lost-or-stolen overrides.
- Every class pays a therapy-change override when the dose changed.

*Illustration (hypothetical):* under a class with an 80 percent threshold, 80 percent of a previous 30-day claim is 24 days; under a class with a 75 percent threshold, 75 percent of the same claim is 22.5 days.
